name: nahuya
description: Over-engineering review for Claude Code: a manual reviewer that proves what it calls unused, a pre-push review-and-fix loop, and a tiny layer that makes unrequested additions visible.

gate.title: Block big unreviewed pushes
gate.description: On: when Claude pushes more unreviewed code than the threshold, it runs the cleanup review first. Default: on.

threshold.title: Lines before a review
threshold.description: Unreviewed added lines that make the gate block, counted across pushes. Tests, docs and generated files don't count. Blank means 500.

layer.title: Show what Claude added
layer.description: On: Claude ends a reply with 'added: X — why' for anything beyond the task. Costs about 120 tokens per session. Default: on.

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model of the review subagent. inherit: the same as your session. A cheaper model costs less and misses more. Default: inherit.

fix_mode.title: Where fixes go
fix_mode.description: commit: a new commit on top (default). amend: folded into the last commit if it isn't pushed. uncommitted: left in the working tree, no push.

depth.title: Review depth
depth.description: auto (default): deep for repo and folder cleanups, normal before a push. deep also reports small findings, duplicates across files and comment bloat.

max_rounds.title: Rounds per review
max_rounds.description: Review-and-fix rounds before a review stops; each round after the first checks the fixes. Blank means 3.

passes.title: Passes per cleanup
passes.description: How many times a cleanup reviews its whole result again from scratch. Each pass costs about as much as the first. Blank means 1.

max_agents.title: Reviewers before asking
max_agents.description: Repo and folder cleanups: if more reviewer subagents are needed, Claude asks you first how to proceed. Blank means 10.

shard_lines.title: Lines per reviewer
shard_lines.description: Repo and folder cleanups: about how many lines of code each reviewer subagent reads. Blank means 3000.
